annotations.title: Read a file on a Flowershow site

description: Get the current text of one file on one of the signed-in user's Flowershow sites, e.g. index.md. Use it before changing a page that is already on the site, then publish the whole updated file, so the parts you didn't mean to change stay as they are. Text files only (Markdown, HTML, CSS, JS, JSON, ...), up to 256 KB. Get siteId from list-sites and paths from list-files. If the user is not signed in yet, calling it asks them to sign in to Flowershow first.

path.description: Path of the file, as returned by list-files

siteId.description: siteId of the site, from list-sites

name: read-file
title: Read a file on a Flowershow site
